The cafeteria will serve a reduced menu while the kitchen equipment is serviced. Parking passes for visitors can be requested at reception on arrival. Our mailing address has not changed, even though the suite sign outside was updated. The building lobby is being repainted, so visitors should use the side entrance on weekdays. Remember that phishing awareness training is available to partners at no cost. The regional meetup was well attended and slides are available on request.
